# Criticality_Driven_Coding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A principle where neural systems under efficient coding constraints self-organize toward criticality, a state of maximal information transmission and dynamic range. Provides a theoretical foundation for designing neuromorphic systems that operate at optimal computational capacity without explicit tuning.
